ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a secondary distribution of high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated on the lateral margins, yielding an estimated 4:1 dark-to-light ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white/mottled) pixels are clustered at the distal 15% of both the left and right lobes; the central 70% of the surface area is characterized by a contiguous block of low-intensity (black) pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45-50 degrees and a depth of roughly 10-12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations present along the entire superior trailing edge of both lobes, featuring peak-to-valley amplitudes varying between 3 and 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a broad convex sweep that terminates in sharp, upward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, high-contrast circular white pixel clusters (rosettes) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with epibiont colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple fine, light-gray linear pixel disruptions oriented vertically and diagonally are visible across the dark-pigmented surfaces of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small irregular notch is visible on the superior edge of the right lobe, approximately 10% lateral to the median notch; significant calcified clusters are present on both distal lobe tips.
